Bigg Boss 20 Contestant Faces Criticism for Comments

Bigg Boss 20 contestant Kazi Tauqeer is facing criticism for alleged comments made inside the house. Social media reactions to these comments are divided. One report specifically mentions a 'lollipop' comment and a 'double meaning' remark, while another refers to him calling someone a 'Ganjii Gudiya' (bald doll).
